strategy.positioning: Football and basketball squares, run by Jax and live now at jaxsquares.com. No app for players, no signup, no math, and no money between players: JaxSquares never collects or sends it. Free to set up and invite; boards with up to 5 players draw free, bigger boards are a $4.99 host fee (or the $19.99/yr Host Pass). Competitors charge per grid ($10–$13), need a download, or need an account. Nobody in the category has a personality-led Instagram, and nobody else has a dog.

cadence: Launch (Oct 22–30): one grid Reel a day, nothing else in the feed. Reels reach the most people who don't follow you yet, which is everyone at launch.
After that, 4–5 feed posts a week: about 4 Reels and 1 carousel. Buffer's 2026 data: 3–5 posts/week roughly doubles follower growth vs. 1–2.
Stories on most days, always on game days, each with a link sticker to start a board.
Best slots (ET): Tue 1–7 PM and Wed 12–9 PM are strongest; Mon 2–4 PM and Thu 12–2 PM are good. Game-day boards go up 11 AM–12:30 PM Sunday and 6–7:30 PM before TNF/MNF.
rules: Hook in the first second. Every video opens on its headline, because Instagram now reports skip rate on Reels.

Optimize for sends. 'Sends per reach' is one of Instagram's top ranking signals for reaching non-followers, so every caption ends with one specific send prompt ('send this to whoever got 2–2'), never 'tag a friend'.
Max 5 hashtags. Instagram capped it at 5 on Dec 18, 2025. Use specific tags, never #reels or #explore.
Keywords first. Captions and alt text feed Instagram search and Google. Lead with 'football squares' or 'squares pool'.
Original content only. Instagram cuts recommendations for reposted content and for videos with other apps' watermarks. Everything here is original and has no watermarks.
Reply to every comment in the first hour after posting. Answer good questions with 'Reply with Reel'.
compliance: Say 'the big game', never 'Super Bowl', in posts and ads (NFL trademark). Team names are fine to identify a game. No logos, uniforms, team colors, broadcast footage or player photos.
Never use the words the app bans: bet, wager, pot, payout, buy-in, jackpot, odds, stakes, gamble (and 'cash out'). Say 'board', 'square price', 'prize', 'bragging rights'.
No money between players, ever. JaxSquares never collects, holds or sends it, so never imply it handles winnings. Prizes in captions are notes: 'loser buys wings', 'winner skips dish duty'.

'Free' means free to set up, invite and pick squares, and free to draw with up to 5 players. Bigger boards have a $4.99 host fee at the draw (the Host Pass covers it). Say 'free to set up'; never call a big board totally free. Players never pay.

Paid boosts: only creatives with no amounts on screen (the Just for fun ones are safest; skip any that show the create flow's review step, which carries the host-fee line). Meta requires prior written permission for ads where money is part of both entry and prize. Boost candidates: 02 Let Jax pick, 04 best and worst squares, 07 feature rundown, u2 bar TV, u4 every phone, u6 join from the link. Not 01 or u1: they show the create flow's host-fee line.
Bars and offices: pitch Just for fun boards with no purchase needed to pick a square.
Giveaways need official rules, eligibility, and a 'not sponsored by Instagram' line. Don't require follows or tags to enter. Skip them for this launch.
Keep 'Not affiliated w/ NFL, NBA or NCAA' in the bio.

strategy.targets: Stretch targets, not forecasts: 400+ followers and 150+ boards created by Nov 29, and one Reel past 10k views. Benchmarks for brand-new accounts are thin; the boards count matters more than followers.

grid.summary: Your first nine posts are nine Reels, one a day (Thu Oct 22 to Fri Oct 30). Each explains one thing about JaxSquares and can reach people who don't follow you yet, and each has a square of the JaxSquares mark as its cover, so the profile turns into the 3×3 logo with the gold winning square. Instagram fills the grid newest-first from the top left, so the board goes up from the bottom right.
rules: First archive the four static squares from Wednesday night and update the name and bio, so the Reels start on a clean grid.
One grid Reel a day, in order (1 → 9). Upload its grid cover as the Reel cover and check the Profile grid tab before you share.
Nothing else in the feed until square 9 is up: one extra post shifts the logo by a square. Game-day posts and the on-this-day video go in Stories.
Don't pin anything: pinned posts jump to the top of the grid and break the logo.
After square 9, later posts slide the board down a square at a time. It lines up again whenever the posts since then reach a multiple of three; in between, every tile is still a whole board square.

items.title: Founder Reel: why we built it (and who Jax is)
script: 0–2s (on-screen text): “I built a squares app because our group chat broke.”
2–10s: hold up the old way. Show the whiteboard photo, the spreadsheet, the 99+ unread chat.
10–25s: screen-record making a real board, start to share link (you recorded this in Prep).
25–35s, to camera: “Free to set up, no app, no signup. Jax draws the numbers live, winners light up.” If you can, film the real Jax here: he's the logo.
35–40s, ask: “What do we build next: Pick'em, Bracket Battles, or King of the Hill?”
items.caption:
Why we built JaxSquares 🐶 (and what's next)

Our squares lived in a group chat, a blurry whiteboard photo and a spreadsheet nobody could find. So we built the board we wanted, and named it after Jax: one link, everyone picks from their phone, numbers draw live, winners light up.

Next up: Pick'em, Bracket Battles or King of the Hill? Vote in the comments 👇
notes: Film vertical, natural light, captions on (Instagram's auto-captions are fine).
